name: Lucretia's Legacy
source: In Lucretia's Legacy, you play a vampire who has just been bitten. The game is about pursuing Master/slave relationships with several women, while thwarting the plans of an evil vampire. There are 10 girls to choose from
translation: 在卢克丽霞的遗产中，你扮演一个刚刚被咬的吸血鬼。该游戏讲述的是与几个女人追求主/奴隶关系，同时挫败邪恶吸血鬼的计划。有10个女孩可供选择
